verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const proxy=r('proxy.ts');const host=r('lib/sites/host.ts');const page=r('components/sites/site-page.tsx');const prof=r('lib/spaces/profile-metadata.ts');const robots=r('app/hosted/[host]/robots.txt/route.ts');const sm=r('app/hosted/[host]/sitemap.xml/route.ts');const cfg=proxy.slice(proxy.indexOf('export const config'));const miss=[];if(!/missing:\s*\[\{\s*type:\s*'host'/.test(cfg)||!/source:\s*'\/\(robots[^']*sitemap/.test(cfg)||!/SITE_CRAWLER_FILES\.has\(pathname\)\)\s*return\s*\{\s*kind:\s*'rewrite'/.test(host))miss.push('a custom domain still serves Frequency robots.txt and sitemap.xml');if(!/siteRobotsTxt\(/.test(robots)||!/siteSitemapXml\(/.test(sm))miss.push('there is no site robots.txt or sitemap.xml route');const a=page.indexOf('export async function siteMetadata');const meta=a<0?'':page.slice(a,page.indexOf('export async function SitePage'));if(!/alternates:\s*\{\s*canonical/.test(meta)||!/index:\s*true/.test(meta)||!/boundSiteDomain\(/.test(meta))miss.push('a published site is still noindex or has no canonical on its domain');if(!/icons:/.test(meta)||!/images/.test(meta))miss.push('the site wears no brand favicon or share image');if(!/resolveProfileSiteCanonical\(/.test(prof)||!/boundSiteDomain\(/.test(r('lib/sites/profile-canonical.ts')))miss.push('the Space profile does not point its canonical at the site domain');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-783: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Measures the consequence at each seam: a site host's crawler files reach the proxy and rewrite to the site's own robots and sitemap routes, those routes build the site's files, a published site page is indexable with a canonical computed from its bound domain plus a brand favicon and share image, and the profile canonical follows the domain. Failed on main before this change (the matcher had no host arm, siteMetadata was noindex with no canonical).

append.detail: Canonical extraction follow-up: retain every existing crawler and metadata assertion while following profile metadata through the shared profile-canonical bound-domain helper. LIVE-1337 adds actual-source readiness/activation consequences and focused profile/directory/sitemap regressions.
